text: Results from this preliminary experimental study indicate that breathwork is associated with larger acute psychedelic-like effects than meditation, alongside greater emotional breakthrough, insight, and self-reported behavioral change. These exploratory relationships and preliminary observations provide greater context around breathwork-induced ASCs, and support the feasibility of ASC-focused breathwork research for future confirmatory trials.
source_label: An exploratory study of breathwork-induced altered states of consciousness in experienced practitioners: the airways to alteration (A2A) trial
